title: HANOI BY NIGHT FOOD TOUR
summary: Hop on the back of the scooter as we take you to enjoy one of the most famous dishes in Hanoi—Bún Chả—at a local restaurant famously visited by President Obama.
inclusions: All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour
html:
ITINERARY

  • Hop on the back of the scooter as we take you to enjoy one of the most famous dishes in Hanoi—Bún Chả—at a local restaurant famously visited by President Obama.
  • Our next stop is the French Quarter to see the Hanoi Opera House, where you will have the opportunity to take beautiful photos and learn some history of the area.
  • We then ride to Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built more than a hundred years ago. It spans the Red River, connecting Hoan Kiem and Long Bien districts, and provides shelter for locals living on boats underneath. Only motorbikes and bicycles can cross it—so off we go!
  • Back on the scooter, we continue along the beautiful Ceramic Road and Chuong Duong Bridge to reach our next food stop, where you will enjoy “Burned Garlic Siamese Duck” and “Liver Pâté Siamese Duck.”
  • The exciting ride through organized, chaotic Hanoi traffic brings you to another local restaurant for authentic dishes. Then we explore small alleys to try different versions of Pho, including Pho Chien Phong and Pho Cuon, along with many other famous Vietnamese dishes.
  • A ride around West Lake offers a romantic view of Hanoi that most travelers rarely get the chance to see—an experience filled with “wow” moments. Continuing the tour, we ride around the city and pass by Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum for a night-time photo stop.
  • A short ride later brings us to a traditional Egg Coffee shop, where you will enjoy Hanoi’s famous specialty.
  • We then ride you back to your hotel. Say goodbye

INCLUDED

  • Scooter, fuel, helmet
  • Experienced professional riders
  • English-speaking guides
  • Dinner at local restaurants
  • All entrance fees & cold water throughout the tour
  • Free pick-up and drop-off
  • Raincoat (if needed)
outline: Day 1: HANOI BY NIGHT FOOD TOUR
